title: .onerc.lock v1
description: Reproducible pinning of catalog service versions and tarball SHA256s. Generated by `one lock`; consumed by `one lock --check`.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the lock was generated or last refreshed.

services.description: Map of service ID to its pinned entry. Service IDs follow the catalog v1 pattern (^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$).

version.description: Service version pinned at lock time, as advertised by the catalog (semver recommended but not enforced).

tarball_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA256 of the catalog tarball. Omitted when the catalog source is local FS (no tarball).
